headline: Earnings rise as same-store sales decline deepens
summary_short: Revenue rose 6.4% y/y to $185.6M and net income climbed 16.9% to $31.3M in Q2 FY2026, even as domestic same-store sales fell 7.5% — a steeper decline than the 1.9% drop a year ago — prompting Wingstop to issue updated full-year same-store sales guidance of a 4%-6% decline.
summary_long: Royalty/franchise-fee revenue rose on 102 net new franchise openings (system-wide units +15.5% y/y to 3,255), partly offset by weaker domestic same-store sales (-7.5%) amid continued pressure on consumer spending. Lower bone-in chicken wing costs cut cost of sales to 73.3% of company-owned sales from 75.2%, and reduced stock-compensation expense pulled SG&A down $2.7M; adjusted EBITDA rose 12.5% to $66.6M and adjusted EPS 14.9% to $1.18. Cash fell to $127.5M (-44.1% y/y) after $78.5M of YTD buybacks and $16.7M of dividends paid, while the stockholders' deficit widened to -$773.0M. Wingstop issued updated FY2026 domestic same-store sales guidance of a 4%-6% decline, updated SG&A/SBC/D&A ranges, and reiterated 15%-16% global unit growth and ~$43M net interest expense.
confidence_notes: Regeneration: this summary was force-regenerated per explicit instruction; no prior WING_US_FY2026_Q2 summary existed on disk before this run, so this is a fresh compose, not an overwrite of prior analysis. All KPIs above are the thirteen-weeks-ended (Q2-only) figures, not the twenty-six-weeks-ended (YTD) figures also disclosed in the 10-Q — YTD net income actually fell 48.6% to $61.2M because the year-ago YTD period included a one-time ~$93.8M gain on the sale of Wingstop's non-controlling interest in its UK master franchisee (LPH); that one-off does not appear in the Q2-only figures used here. 'Total cash & equivalents' ($127.5M) is the SEC XBRL CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue tag and excludes the $19.6M of restricted Ad Fund cash that the release's own headline liquidity figure ('$157.4 million of cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash') includes — the two are not directly comparable. Adjusted net income/EPS/EBITDA are release-disclosed non-GAAP figures (with the release's own GAAP reconciliation) and are not present in the SEC-XBRL-sourced shard KPIs, which carry only GAAP tags. The release describes the 4%-6% domestic same-store-sales decline, SG&A, stock-compensation and D&A ranges as 'updated guidance' without restating the prior range, so guidance.move is left null for those four lines rather than inferring a direction; global unit growth and net interest expense are explicitly 'reiterate[d]', so move='held' for those two.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites the Club Wingstop national launch, investments in value, flavor innovation and Smart Kitchen, and a strong development pipeline as reinforcing confidence in becoming a top global restaurant brand.

Royalty/franchise-fee revenue rose on $11.2M from net new franchise development and higher vendor rebates, partly offset by $5.0M lost to the 7.5% domestic same-store sales decline; advertising fees rose with system-wide sales.
Decline attributed to lower transaction volumes amid continued pressure on consumer spending, per the release.

Cost of sales fell to 73.3% of company-owned sales from 75.2% on a 9.1% drop in bone-in chicken wing costs; SG&A fell $2.7M on lower stock-compensation and payroll, partly offset by higher professional fees.
Share count fell on ongoing buybacks under the $300M repurchase authorization; $78.5M repurchased year-to-date at an average $208.08/share, with $313.4M still authorized.
Cash declined as $78.5M of year-to-date buybacks and $16.7M of dividends paid outpaced $68.3M of operating cash flow.
